mode: Built-in ImageGen; field generation and old battle sheet appearance edits

jobs.prompt: Create production HIGH RESOLUTION PIXEL ART field walking sprites for a JRPG, inspired by Xenogears' articulated body proportions and Square Enix HD-2D sprite craftsmanship. Image1 is identity and BASIC COSTUME reference. Kang Chuheun: tousled ash gray-brown short hair, amber eyes, black martial wrap jacket with COBALT BLUE lapel cuffs and hem, white inner collar, BLACK waist belt, ORANGE vertical panel below belt, loose black trousers, ORANGE AND WHITE SNEAKERS, blue-silver chain bracelet on left wrist. Friendly energetic boy, closed small smile. NO chest insignia, NO gray belt, NO black boots. Mature compact anime body approx4 heads tall, distinctly pixel-cluster shading with controlled palette, crisp deliberate stepped edges, NO smooth painted illustration, NO oversized chibi head. Exactly16 fullbody sprites arranged in perfectly uniform4 columns x4 rows, canvas1536x1536, cell384x384. Keep all feet on baseline350 in every cell and all heads centered horizontally at192. Same scale, standing height290px across all cells; each pose complete head-to-toe. No labels, no text, no ground shadow, no scenery. True transparent alpha around sprites. Keep chain as compact bracelet only for walking, do not distract from legs. Top TWO rows are a single walking cycle facing FRONT (walking toward camera). Bottom TWO rows repeat the same ordered poses facing BACK (walking away from camera). Within each 8-pose group reading left to right: [0] upright stationary feet parallel under hips; [1] LEFT-leg forward contact, right leg back, RIGHT arm forward; [2] LEFT-leg weight-bearing while RIGHT knee passes forward under body; [3] RIGHT-leg forward contact, left leg back, LEFT arm forward; [4] RIGHT-leg weight-bearing while LEFT knee passes forward; [5] LEFT-foot planted down-pose, body lowers subtly, right heel lifting behind; [6] RIGHT-foot planted down-pose, left heel lifting behind; [7] stationary relaxed feet parallel. THE CONTACT POSES1 AND3 MUST HAVE OPPOSITE LEADING LEGS, and POSES2 AND4 clearly differ from them. Natural small strides, realistic bending knees/ankles, gentle opposing arm swing, hair follows torso by only a few pixels. Skeleton proportions, torso angle, shoulders, head identity consistent, very little vertical bounce. Animate entire connected bodies, no sliced pasted heads. Transparent background.
